ORDINANCE XXII OF 1983
SPECIFIC RELIEF (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Specific Relief Act, 1877
[Gazette of Pakistan,. Extraordinary, 20th September, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Specific Relief (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
